description: Implementation of a 32-bit Murmur3 hash function for Spark, based on Guava's Murmur3_32HashFunction, including methods for hashing integers, bytes, and long values with support for different byte orders and backward compatibility.

classes.name: Murmur3_x86_32
classes.description: A class providing Murmur3 32-bit hashing functions, including methods for hashing integers, byte arrays, and long values, with support for different byte orders and compatibility modes.

methods.name: hashInt
methods.description: Hashes an integer input with the instance's seed.

methods.name: hashUnsafeWords
methods.description: Hashes a block of memory represented by an object, offset, and length, assuming word-aligned data.

methods.name: hashUnsafeBytes
methods.description: Hashes a byte array segment, with a backward-compatible implementation.

methods.name: hashUnsafeBytes2
methods.description: Hashes a byte array segment, using a method compatible with the original implementation for Spark 2.3 and later.

methods.name: hashLong
methods.description: Hashes a long value with the instance's seed.
